ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha 49a7631b1ddb (2026-05-16T12:04:07Z) modified deploy/redis/redis.conf and deploy/redis/configmap.yaml, setting the Redis `save` config directive to an empty string (`save ""`). This was likely intended as a temporary workaround to silence a preceding RDB snapshot failure alert during profiling setup, but it fully disabled RDB persistence. With `appendonly` also set to `no`, neither RDB nor AOF persistence is active, leaving all 143,000+ keys in memory only and at risk of total loss on any pod restart or crash.
ground_truth_remediation:
1. Immediately run `CONFIG SET save "3600 1 300 100 60 10000"` on redis-primary-01 to re-enable RDB persistence without a restart, protecting the live key set. 2. Revert deploy/redis/redis.conf and deploy/redis/configmap.yaml in the 49a7631b1ddb commit to restore `save 3600 1
save 300 100
save 60 10000` and redeploy the configmap. 3. Trigger a manual `BGSAVE` to create an immediate on-disk snapshot. 4. Verify `redis_rdb_last_bgsave_status=ok` and `redis_rdb_last_save_timestamp_seconds > 0` in the redis-exporter metrics to confirm persistence is restored.
